Create an EXACT edge-to-edge 3 by 3 grid of nine equal square portrait photographs, no gutters or borders. Each cell contains one DIFFERENT fictional East Asian adult, head and shoulders centered in the cell, full hair visible with breathing room, friendly natural expression, plain athletic shirt, neutral blue-gray studio background. Natural diverse faces and realistic age-appropriate skin, varied hairstyles, no beauty retouching. Row 1: man age 24, woman age 31, man age 38. Row 2: woman age 45, man age 52, woman age 59. All nine square panels must align perfectly.
